structure: Part 14, Manage notifications: all 7 traces of manage-notifications.fit.spec.js, every one opened and mined (action list, network log, snapshots and DOM evals of each page reached). Trace zips under workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/traces-prototype/, named in refs by basename: VIEW-AR = manage-notifications--view-a-notification-from-the-dashboard-submitted-with-action-required-warning-import-references-read-only-answers (34 actions); VIEW-SCD = manage-notifications--view-a-notification-from-the-dashboard-submitted-completed-and-draft-notifications (43 actions, 3 steps); AMEND = manage-notifications--amend-a-submitted-notification-confirm-change-an-answer-save-and-return-then-resubmit (95 actions); CANCEL = manage-notifications--amend-a-submitted-notification-cancel-an-amendment-from-the-amend-review (25 actions); GUARDS = manage-notifications--amend-and-copy-guards-cancel-amend-with-no-amendment-in-progress-and-unknown-references-return-to-the-dashboard (25 actions); COPY = manage-notifications--copy-as-new-copying-a-submitted-notification-opens-a-new-draft-on-the-hub (24 actions); DELETE = manage-notifications--delete-a-notification-confirm-the-deletion-the-dashboard-shows-a-success-banner (41 actions). Action ids are the numbers in each trace's `actions` list; request ids the numbers in its `requests` list. Pages reached, in the order a trader meets them: (1) the live-animals dashboard (/design-release-2.1/live-animals), entered only to click View or Copy as new (its own copy belongs to the dashboard part); (2) view notification (/review-notification?reference=...), one template in four states: Submitted action required (GBN-AG-26-7K8M2P), Submitted (GBN-AG-26-7K8M2U), Completed (GBN-AG-26-7K8M2W) and Draft (GBN-GP-26-7K8M2T), with a page header (reference h1, status tag, action buttons, date), an Import reference numbers section, and six numbered read-only answer sections; (3) the amend confirmation modal on the view page (Submitted and action-required only); (4) the amend review (/notifications/amend?reference=... redirects to /review-notification), with an Amend status bar, Change links, Continue, Cancel amend and Delete; (5) question pages opened from the amend review (Origin of the import, Arrival details), carrying the Amend status bar and Save and return / Save and continue / Save and return to overview; (6) the cancel-amendment modal; (7) the declaration and the Import notification submitted page at the end of an amendment; (8) copy as new (/notifications/copy-as-new?reference=...) redirecting to the notification hub (Overview) as a new Draft; (9) the delete confirmation page (/notifications/delete?reference=...) and, after Yes, delete, the overall dashboard (/design-release-2.1) then the live-animals dashboard with a success banner; (10) the guards: /notifications/cancel-amend with nothing in progress, and amend or copy-as-new with an unknown reference, each redirect to the overall dashboard. Conditional: the Amend button appears only for Submitted and Submitted action required; the warning line only for action required; Change links and the error summary only on Draft and the amend review; Continue only on Draft, action required and the amend review. Integrations: every call is a same-origin GOV.UK Prototype Kit page request or form post; no outbound API calls appear in any of the 7 network logs.
